title: PublicEntry
description: Shape of each entry in data/public-opportunities.json (the 'jobs', 'hackathons', and 'events' arrays are all built from this same entry shape, disambiguated by 'kind'). This is a different, simpler shape than config/job-entry.schema.json, which describes data/jobs-global.json instead.

id.description: 16-char hex ID (stable hash of source-specific fields, always including title+url)

kind.description: Which of the three arrays this entry belongs to; 'level' and 'role_type' are only present when kind is 'job'

title.description: Job title, hackathon name, or event name

location.description: Free-form location string; 'Various' or 'Global' when not a single place

level.description: Career level detected from title. Only present when kind is 'job'

role_type.description: Engineering discipline detected from title. Only present when kind is 'job'

region.description: Coarse region detected from location, same taxonomy as the curated layer's region field ('mena' = Middle East & Africa, matched before 'emea'). Only present when kind is 'job'

date.description: Human-readable time-since-posting for jobs (e.g. '0d'), submission deadline for hackathons (e.g. '1 day left'), or '' for events. Free-form, not machine-parseable across kinds

posted_at.description: Date this entry was posted or collected (YYYY-MM-DD), or '' when the source only exposes a fuzzy relative date instead of a real timestamp (e.g. Workday's 'Posted 3 Days Ago' — see the 'date' field for that fuzzy value instead)

url.description: Link to the posting. Usually an absolute URL, but Luma events use a site-relative path (e.g. '/some-event?k=c')

source_url.description: Source API or website URL for attribution
